basic_profile.bio: An avid tech enthusiast and gamer from Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance web developer and enjoy tinkering with smart home gadgets in my free time. When I'm not coding or gaming, you might find me exploring local food spots or playing pickup basketball. I'm usually online late at night, often after 10 PM, when I have some downtime. Single and enjoying the freedom to pursue my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been self-teaching various programming languages since high school. I have a strong foundation in web development and a keen interest in emerging technologies, particularly smart home automation. My understanding of technology is both academically grounded and fueled by personal projects.
